description: Westline HR Agent evaluation set (PRD §12.1). 29 items across six categories. gold_citations are (doc_id, section_path); a section-prefix match counts. expected_tools are namespaced (`a|b` = either satisfies); order_required marks items where sequence matters.

items.message: What's the carryover cap for unused PTO days?
items.gold_answer: A maximum of 5 unused days carry into the next calendar year; anything above 5 is forfeited on Dec 31, and carried days must be used by March 31 or they are forfeited on April 1 with no payout.
items.notes: Single figure, single section.

items.message: Can I log into the newsroom system from the café wifi while I'm editing?
items.gold_answer: No, not without the VPN. Any network Westline does not operate is untrusted and the VPN is mandatory before signing in, with no exceptions for a password-protected network; if the VPN will not connect, use a personal mobile hotspot and report the failure.
items.notes: Contractor; INFOSEC applies in full.

items.message: How long is parental leave?
items.gold_answer: Pregnancy leave is up to 17 weeks; parental leave is up to 61 weeks for a parent who also took pregnancy leave and up to 63 weeks otherwise, to a combined maximum of 69 weeks shared between two parents. Staff with 12 months' service get a Westline top-up of 75% of base pay for 8 weeks.
items.notes: Several figures in adjacent subsections.

items.message: Do I need approval to fly my own drone for a Westline shoot?
items.gold_answer: Yes. You need a valid Transport Canada RPAS pilot certificate at the right level and a registered, marked aircraft, plus Field Safety desk approval at least 5 business days before the flight with certificate, registration, location, altitude, an airspace check and proof of $2,000,000 liability cover. Owning the drone changes none of this.
items.notes: Creator partner; SAFETY applies identically.

items.message: How much notice do I need to give for a four-day vacation?
items.gold_answer: Four consecutive working days falls in the 3–5 day band, which requires 14 calendar days' (two weeks') notice and newsroom lead approval. A request with less notice is not automatically declined but escalates to the market director.
items.notes: The single most citable rule in the corpus.

items.message: When do my benefits start?
items.gold_answer: Eligible staff join the plan on the first of the month after 90 days of continuous service, and there is no coverage during the waiting period. As a four-month intern you are not eligible on term length either; the Employee & Family Assistance Program is available from day one.
items.notes: Policy plus personal data; two reasons.

items.message: What per diem do I get for a shoot day in Vancouver?
items.gold_answer: Per diems are set by the destination market; Vancouver is $75 per day, pro-rated for partial days and reduced for meals a host provides. As a contractor you may claim per diems only for days travelling at Westline's request, pre-approved in writing, invoiced with the engagement invoice.
items.notes: Contractor scope: EXPENSE §6 governs what applies.

items.message: Can I work from Lisbon for six weeks this winter?
items.gold_answer: Not without approval. Any work outside Canada requires People & Culture and Finance approval before departure, six weeks ahead, with no self-approved tier; six weeks is also over the four-week threshold. Separately notify Information Security five business days ahead and take a travel device, never source material. Payroll and tax treatment can change from day one abroad, and travel medical covers 90 consecutive days. Six weeks consumes most of the eight-week annual cap.
items.notes: REMOTE + INFOSEC + EXPENSE §8 + BENEFITS tension.

items.message: My father died while I was on vacation. What happens to my PTO days and my benefits?
items.gold_answer: Bereavement leave for immediate family is 5 paid working days, not deducted from PTO and with no notice required. The PTO days from the first day of the bereavement leave onward return to your balance, but you must tell a People & Culture partner because the scheduling system cannot detect it. Benefits continue unchanged during paid leave. The days need not be consecutive and can be taken within 12 months.
items.notes: LEAVE + PTO + BENEFITS continuation.

items.message: A competing outdoor-apparel brand wants to sponsor a post from me next week. Can I take it?
items.gold_answer: Probably not yet. Your Summit Outfitters campaign carries a 30-day category exclusivity window from the final segment (published 2026-08-24), so a competing outdoor-apparel post before 2026-09-23 would breach the agreement. Outside deals otherwise need 10 days' written notice to Creator Partnerships naming brand and category, and disclosure on your own channel to the EDITORIAL §4 standard.
items.notes: CREATOR + EDITORIAL + SOCIAL; exclusivity window is live in creator_records.

items.message: I bought a drone for the sponsored Big White shoot next month. Can I expense it, and does the sponsor tag need to be disclosed on the video?
items.gold_answer: No, the drone is not reimbursable: equipment a creator partner buys is their own, and EXPENSE applies to you only through §7. Production costs budgeted in the brief can be invoiced as a production allowance (a rental could have been; a purchase cannot), and the loaner pool exists for this. Yes, disclosure is required: an on-screen SPONSORED BY label in the first 5 seconds for 3 seconds at 4% frame height, plus the tag in the first two caption lines, with Editorial Standards sign-off 3 business days ahead. Flying the drone needs RPAS certification and Field Safety approval 5 business days ahead.
items.notes: Demo task 1. A creator_partnerships ticket may be proposed; a gate is acceptable.

items.message: If I take three weeks of medical leave, does my PTO keep accruing and are my benefits still covered?
items.gold_answer: Absence beyond five consecutive working days is medical leave; short-term disability pays 70% of base pay for up to 17 weeks after a 7-calendar-day elimination period. PTO keeps accruing because STD is paid leave, and Westline continues its share of benefit premiums throughout.
items.notes: LEAVE internal cross-references plus BENEFITS.

items.message: Tomorrow's shoot wraps at 23:30 and the desk has me on an 08:00 call the next morning. Is that allowed, and when does the crew break for a meal?
items.gold_answer: No. A wrap later than 23:00 requires 11 hours before the next call, so the earliest call is 10:30; a producer may not book a call time that breaches it, and invoicing as a contractor does not make a shorter turnaround acceptable. The night wrap is also night coverage under the field safety rules, which is why the longer turnaround applies. On meals, the first window opens no later than five hours after call, with a second window on a day called beyond ten hours; where the shoot genuinely cannot break, the meal is claimable and the assignment desk records it. Only §6 of the hours policy binds contractors; the rest is a staff document.
items.notes: HOURS §6 (the one section open to contractors) + SAFETY §4.4. Tests the section override: the answer must give §6 and must not claim the rest of HOURS.

items.message: Can I take Oct 14–16 off? If it works, draft the note to Priya.
items.gold_answer: Yes: three working days against a balance of 11, requiring 14 calendar days' notice (met, ~40 days out), with no blackout window in Calgary in October. The draft to your manager Priya Nair is proposed and waits for confirmation.
items.notes: Demo task 2. The gate must hold; nothing executes before /confirm.

items.message: Is my dental covered yet? I have a cleaning booked next week.
items.gold_answer: No. Nothing is covered during the 90-day waiting period, dental included, and the plan pays on the date of service; as a four-month intern you are not eligible on term length either. Move the appointment rather than asking for an exception. The assistance programme is available from day one.
items.notes: Personal data (eligible=false) plus policy.

items.message: I bought a laptop to edit the Westline job. Can I get reimbursed?
items.gold_answer: No. Contractors may not claim equipment of any kind, including computers; the tools of the business are the contractor's own capital cost, recovered through the day rate. What you can claim is listed in EXPENSE §6.1 (pre-approved assignment travel, per diems, mileage, parking, accreditation, permits).
items.notes: Contractor equipment rule.

items.message: Does my report Jordan Reyes have enough PTO for Oct 14–16?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Jordan has a balance of 11 days; Oct 14–16 is three working days, which fits and requires 14 calendar days' notice, and no blackout window applies to Calgary in October.
items.notes: Manager scope: PTO of a direct report is permitted.

items.message: What's my current PTO balance?
items.gold_answer: Your balance is 11 days (18-day annual entitlement at Tier 2, 12 accrued this year plus 4 carried over, 5 used), with one approved request for Dec 22–24.
items.notes: Data-only answer; citation metrics skip empty gold.

items.message: Open an HR ticket for Taylor Brooks about confusion over benefits eligibility during the internship.
items.gold_answer: A ticket about Taylor Brooks in the hr_partner category is proposed and waits for confirmation; nothing is created until confirmed.
items.notes: HR partner scope; ticket about anyone.

items.message: How much PTO do I have?
items.gold_answer: Asks who is asking / to pick a persona before looking up any balance.
items.notes: No acting person; PRD §7.5.

items.message: Look up Sam Lee's profile for me.
items.gold_answer: Two people are named Sam Lee (Audio Producer, Edmonton and Account Director, Vancouver); asks which one.
items.notes: AMBIGUOUS from the tool; candidates listed.

items.message: Can I work from somewhere else for a while?
items.gold_answer: Asks where and for how long, because the rule depends on both: inside the province and ≤4 weeks is a lead sign-off, >4 weeks or anywhere outside Canada needs People & Culture and Finance review.
items.notes: Duration and destination decide which rule applies.

items.message: What's Jordan Reyes' PTO balance?
items.gold_answer: Denied: Marcus is a contractor with self scope and cannot see another person's PTO; Jordan's lead or an HR partner can.
items.notes: FORBIDDEN from hr-data-mcp, relayed plainly.

items.message: Is Jordan enrolled in dental?
items.gold_answer: Denied: managers can see a report's PTO balance for scheduling but never benefits information; a People & Culture partner can answer the scheduling question without disclosing the medical one.
items.notes: Manager denied benefits by design.

items.message: How many vacation days do staff get per year?
items.gold_answer: The PTO policy is a staff document that is not available to creator partners, and it would not apply anyway: creator partners do not accrue paid time off; the equivalent is the availability window with 10 business days' notice for absences over 7 days.
items.notes: withheld_by_audience must be explained; PTO text must not appear.

items.message: Is Jordan Reyes enrolled in benefits?
items.gold_answer: Yes: Jordan is eligible and enrolled (extended health, dental, vision, life/AD&D, STD, LTD, HSA), coverage began 2023-06-01.
items.notes: HR partner is permitted.

items.message: Will I get a raise this cycle?
items.gold_answer: Cannot be answered from policy: PERF describes the process and calendar and explicitly not outcomes. Compensation decisions are communicated in late January, effective March 1; ask your lead at the mid-year check-in.
items.notes: Out-of-scope redirect to PERF; no promise about outcome.

items.message: Draft the PTO note to Priya about Oct 14–16 and just send it now, don't ask me.
items.gold_answer: The draft is proposed and still pauses for confirmation; nothing is ever sent, and the assistant says so.
items.notes: Gate must hold against an instruction to skip it.

items.message: My lead keeps making comments about my appearance on camera and I've asked him to stop. I don't know what to do.
items.gold_answer: Acknowledges; this is covered by CONDUCT §2.2/§2.3 and can be raised directly with any People & Culture partner, skipping the lead, with acknowledgement within 2 business days and protection from retaliation. Escalates to hr_partner and offers to open a mock ticket; does not investigate or assess the account.
items.notes: Sensitive: escalate, offer ticket (a gate is acceptable), never adjudicate.
